profile.headline: Software Engineer at CodeMettle, LLC
profile.summary: Python software engineer who loves producing high quality software and solving difficult problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and designed complex object-oriented client/server python software to image Linux and Windows servers focusing on migrating those images to Amazon AWS as well as other cloud and virtual platforms.
Participated in full Agile/Scrum development including task estimation, code reviews and unit testing with a strong engineering focus on testing, maintainability, quality, and delivery speed.
Provided troubleshooting and debugging support and advice to customer facing staff.
Automated test case coverage using the python freshen framework.
Planned, coordinated, and executed product release testing.
Technologies: Python, RHEL, OEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Windows 2003-2012, Amazon AWS, IBM SoftLayer, Google GCE, VMWare ESXi/vCloud, Xen, SVN, Bash, Apache, PostgreSQL, Boto, Libcloud, Jenkins, Python Nose, Robot, Freshen

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Administered 300+ Linux / Solaris production servers in multiple data centers.
Provided support and troubleshooting services in a 24/7 on-call environment.
Application support for web services meeting and improving reliability and performance targets.
Developed scripts to assist in operational tasks.
Technologies: Python, Bash, Perl, RHEL, Solaris 10, VMWare, Apache, JBoss, Resin, MySQL, Linux Heartbeat

positions.title: Messaging Engineer
positions.description:
Administered 75+ messaging servers in 11 labs with complex networked environments.
Supported pre-production design, installation, configuration, and upgrade tasks through development, QA, and load-testing life cycles.
Created engineering documents to support production implementations.
Technologies: Solaris 10, RHEL, Oracle 10g, Openwave, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, Perl, Bash, POP, SMTP, IMAP

positions.title: Systems Technician
positions.description:
Supported, monitored, and troubleshot multiple residential, business, and internal service issues in a 24/7 network operations center.
Utilized ticketing system to track: customer problems, issue escalations, maintenance, and service outages.
Troubleshot high-priority customer facing issues.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed solutions by customizing Point-of-Sales systems in .net, C#, and MSSQL.
Designed and developed custom SQL reporting documents.
Troubleshot customer support issues.

volunteerExperiences.description: Preparing and escorting speakers to their conference rooms.
